US.description: Groceries, transportation, utilities, and personal expenses, excluding rent.

IN.description: Covers groceries, local transport, utilities, dining out, and basic entertainment for a moderate lifestyle.

SG.description: High cost of living, particularly for groceries, dining out, transportation, and imported goods.

CH.description: Generally very high across all categories including groceries, public transport, healthcare, and dining out.

NL.description: Covers groceries, public transport, basic utilities, and average entertainment expenses.

GB.description: Overall cost of living excluding rent, reflecting higher prices for groceries, transportation, and utilities compared to baseline, particularly in urban areas.

CA.description: Covers groceries, transportation, utilities, and basic leisure activities for an average lifestyle.

AE.description: High cost of living, particularly for dining out and entertainment; groceries and transportation are moderate.

NO.description: Overall high cost of living, particularly for groceries, transportation, and dining out, while utilities are relatively moderate.

IE.description: High for groceries, utilities, and transport, especially in major cities. Costs are lower in rural areas.

LU.description: High cost for most goods and services, particularly groceries and dining; utilities and transportation are also above average.

AU.description: Cost of living excluding rent is generally high, covering groceries, utilities, transportation, and personal expenses. Varies by city and lifestyle.

QA.description: The cost of living excluding rent in Qatar is high, especially for groceries, imported goods, and dining out, reflecting a generally affluent lifestyle. Utilities tend to be more affordable.

BN.description: Cost of living excluding rent is generally low, driven by affordable groceries, utilities, and transportation compared to international averages.

MO.description: The cost of living in Macao, excluding rent, is generally high, especially for imported goods and services in tourist areas. Local food and public transportation can be more affordable.
